# HeatEx Direct

> HeatEx Direct is a global sourcing information platform for industrial buyers. It helps procurement teams discover, compare, and evaluate Chinese heat exchanger manufacturers through structured factory profiles, product data, technical content, and verified-email quote request intake.

HeatEx Direct is not a single heat exchanger manufacturer and is not a broad marketplace. The site focuses on Chinese industrial heat exchanger manufacturers and related thermal transfer equipment. It is designed for procurement teams, engineers, EPC contractors, distributors, system integrators, and manufacturer export teams.

Important interpretation notes:

- Manufacturer and product pages are intended for preliminary sourcing research and technical review.
- Quote requests are collected through a structured intake workflow; submitting a request does not guarantee instant quotation, automatic supplier matching, supplier response, or commercial result.
- Manufacturer profiles may include public information, supplier-provided materials, editorial summaries, media, certificates, documents, and external links. Buyers should perform their own due diligence before procurement.
- Industry News includes company news, technical articles, sourcing articles, market data, and product/application notes.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://heatexdirect.com/): Platform overview for global buyers researching Chinese heat exchanger manufacturers.
- [Manufacturers](https://heatexdirect.com/manufacturers): Directory of listed Chinese heat exchanger manufacturers.
- [Products](https://heatexdirect.com/products): Industrial heat exchanger product catalogue with product detail pages and related manufacturers.
- [Quote Request](https://heatexdirect.com/quote-request): Verified-email heat exchanger quote request intake for project context, operating conditions, files, and technical parameters.
- [Industry News](https://heatexdirect.com/industry-news): Company news, technical articles, sourcing articles, and heat exchanger market intelligence.
- [About](https://heatexdirect.com/about): Platform identity, scope, audience, and information service positioning.
- [Contact](https://heatexdirect.com/contact): Contact page for sourcing questions, manufacturer updates, article submissions, and corrections.

## Manufacturer Profiles

- [Shanghai Accessen Co., Ltd.](https://heatexdirect.com/manufacturers/shanghai-accessen-co-ltd): Data center cooling and heat exchange solutions, including plate heat exchangers and prefabricated thermal systems.
- [Siping Juyuan Hanyang Plate Heat Exchanger Co., Ltd.](https://heatexdirect.com/manufacturers/siping-juyuan-hanyang-plate-heat-exchanger-co-ltd): Plate heat exchanger and heat exchange system manufacturer.
- [Shanghai Heat Transfer Equipment Co., Ltd.](https://heatexdirect.com/manufacturers/shanghai-heat-transfer-equipment-co-ltd): Plate heat exchanger and custom heat transfer system manufacturer.
- [Lanzhou Lanshi Heat Exchange Equipment Co., Ltd.](https://heatexdirect.com/manufacturers/lanzhou-lanshi-heat-exchange-equipment-co-ltd): Plate heat exchangers, welded heat exchangers, PCHE systems, and heat exchange units.
- [Siping ViEX Heat Exchange Equipment Co., Ltd.](https://heatexdirect.com/manufacturers/siping-viex-heat-exchange-equipment-co-ltd): Plate, tubular, spiral, air-side, and integrated heat exchange equipment.

## Product Catalogue

- [Industrial Heat Exchanger Product Catalogue](https://heatexdirect.com/products): Main product index for plate, welded plate, shell-and-tube, air-side, spare parts, and heat exchange unit products.
- [Gasketed Plate Heat Exchanger](https://heatexdirect.com/products/shanghai-heat-transfer-equipment-co-ltd/gasketed-plate-heat-exchanger): Plate and frame heat exchanger details, materials, applications, and technical specifications.
- [Wide Gap Welded Plate Heat Exchanger](https://heatexdirect.com/products/shanghai-heat-transfer-equipment-co-ltd/wide-gap-welded-plate-heat-exchanger): Welded wide-gap exchanger for viscous, fiber-laden, and particle-containing fluids.
- [Tubular Heat Exchanger](https://heatexdirect.com/products/siping-viex-heat-exchange-equipment-co-ltd/tubular-heat-exchanger): Shell-and-tube heat exchanger product entry.
- [Air Heat Exchanger](https://heatexdirect.com/products/siping-viex-heat-exchange-equipment-co-ltd/air-heat-exchanger): Finned-tube air heat exchanger product entry.
